notes: Build 2 @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ with the @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ one at@resource/resource_stone.webp@ one at@resource/resource_gold.webp@

Add every @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ spawned to the@resource/resource_food.webp@. With 1 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@ build @building_economy/house.webp@
When possible, build @building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@ a keep @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ layout in mind
When possible @landmark_ottomans/twin-minaret-medrese-1.webp@ , with 4 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ and send 1 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
After @landmark_ottomans/twin-minaret-medrese-1.webp@ leaving 4 on @resource/resource_food.webp@ and sending every new spawned @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@

When possible, build 2nd @building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@ and @building_military/archery-range.webp@/r @building_military/stable.webp@ or @building_military/barracks.webp@ choose it for your opponent to be countered

Get @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ , and @technology_economy/horticulture.webp@ instead of because you will need wood, and with @technology_economy/horticulture.webp@ you, you will collect @resource/sheep.webp@ faster

If you want to @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ push with @technology_defensive/arrow-slits.webp@ them, stay one @resource/resource_stone.webp@ with one, but if you are not gonna do that, take him and give him to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ or @resource/resource_food.webp@
